Claiming more on each of 167 aliases therefore forfeits more proof of work per key, so the reward curve cannot be farmed at a fixed price and the marginal alias loses value as it climbs. The stamp difficulty for an answer scales with the reward it claims, reaching 18 bits at the top of the range. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
